constants_basis: Chosen on synthetic Mound F-shaped populations in design-v1/power-quick.json: opening and closing categories need at least 5 legends and inventory signs at least 8 (false-positive rates 0.03-0.07, power 0.61-0.66 for a period-specific opening in one legend of four, 0.58 for a period-specific interior sign in one legend of two, 0.96 for period-specific closing signs in half the stock-closing legends); the equivalence margin of 0.25 passes 54% of null populations and 11% of populations with a true 0.20 shift; the permutation fail rule replaces the bootstrap 95% rule, which failed 7.7% of null populations.
